headline: VICI Properties (NYSE:VICI) Misses Q2 Earnings Forecast, Stock Dips After Hours
summary: VICI Properties Q2 AFFO of $0.62 missed estimates by 14%, sending shares lower. Revenue hit $1.1B, up 5.7% YoY, with portfolio expansion and updated guidance.

headline: VICI Properties Inc. Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: NEW YORK, July 29, 2026--VICI Properties Inc. (NYSE: VICI) ("VICI Properties", "VICI" or the "Company"), an experiential real estate investment trust, today reported results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. All per share amounts included herein are on a per diluted common share basis unless otherwise stated.

headline: Boomers Are Buying 5 Quality High-Yield Stocks at Big Discounts Hand Over Fist
summary: Retirement means living off your portfolio, not waiting for it to grow, and right now five familiar dividend giants are trading at prices that Wall Street considers deeply undervalued.
